messages:
jo (Billing Ops): Flagging an issue from today's invoice run: two customers received two PDFs with same invoice_id; one PDF omitted compute usage lines (shows $0) while ledger shows correct charge. sample excerpt below. :frowning:
jo (Billing Ops): Excerpt: Invoice 2025-06-INV-0042 - PDF A shows usage $0, PDF B shows usage $280. Ledger charge: $280.
liam (FinOps): That sounds like a pdf-render retry/dedupe problem. invoices-bot, any duplicate alerts?
invoices-bot: ALERT duplicate invoice_id detected: 2025-06-INV-0042 (count=2) in batch invoice_run_2025_06_30.
anita (Payments): Pausing invoice-email-sender for today's batch. We don't want confusing PDFs going out.
sam (Support): Customer already asked if they were underbilled. I'll tell them charge is correct and we'll resend corrected PDF.
jo (Billing Ops): Quick recon: invoice_lines and ledger match; invoice_pdfs table has two rows for the invoice_id. Renderer logs: "WARN render(): retry produced empty usage block when feature_flag compact_invoices=true"
liam (FinOps): Proposed remediation: 1) pause email sends (done) 2) dedupe invoice_pdfs (keep pdf matching invoice_lines) 3) re-render any missing PDFs with renderer pinned to prior stable version or hotfix 4) re-send corrected PDFs with short note.
anita (Payments): I'll hold captures for impacted customers and resume after QA.
jo (Billing Ops): Filing FIN-2025-401 and assigning to eng-render. Will update once re-render and resend complete. :white_check_mark:
